name: SUNMED
recent: Sunway Healthcare 在2026年11月19日公布季度业绩，净利按年增长59.4%至9,517万令吉，营收增长24.3%至7.374亿令吉。同期，公司完成多项ESOS新股发行，并宣布收购Sunway Medical Centre Velocity A座物业的买卖协议已于10月29日成为无条件。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）在11月持续申报股权变动。
notable: 2026年第三季度净利按年增长59.4%至9,517万令吉，营收增长24.3%至7.374亿令吉。
收购Sunway Medical Centre Velocity A座物业的买卖协议（代价2.285亿令吉）已于2026年10月29日成为无条件。
2026年11月19日宣布委员会成员变动，同日生效。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年11月多次申报股权变动，需留意其持股变化。
公司持续通过ESOS发行新股，可能对现有股东持股产生轻微摊薄。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为7.374亿令吉，按年增长24.3%，按季增长9.6%；净利为9,517万令吉，按年增长59.4%，按季增长21.8%；净利率为12.9%，高于上一季度的11.6%。

recent_en: Sunway Healthcare reported quarterly results on 19 November 2026, with net profit up 59.4% year-on-year to RM95.17 million and revenue up 24.3% to RM737.44 million. During the period, the company completed several ESOS share issuances and announced that the SPA for the acquisition of Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity became unconditional on 29 October. The Employees Provident Fund Board also continued to file changes in its shareholding in November.
notable_en: 3Q2026 net profit rose 59.4% year-on-year to RM95.17 million, with revenue up 24.3% to RM737.44 million.
The SPA for the acquisition of Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity (consideration RM228.5 million) became unconditional on 29 October 2026.
Committee changes were announced on 19 November 2026, effective the same day.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple changes in its shareholding in November 2026; its stake changes should be monitored.
The company continues to issue new shares under its ESOS, which may slightly dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM737.44 million, up 24.3% year-on-year and 9.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM95.17 million, up 59.4% year-on-year and 21.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 12.9%, higher than 11.6% in the previous quarter.
